references: The Phoenix Suns defeated the Milwaukee Bucks, 116 - 114, at Fiserv Forum on Friday evening. The Suns (4 - 14) came into Saturday's contest still seeking their first road win of the season, and facing quite the uphill battle versus a Bucks (13 - 5) squad that had only dropped one home game. However, Phoenix made a statement by taking a 64 - 61 halftime lead, and they proved it wasn't a fluke by essentially hanging with Milwaukee basket for basket in the second half. The game was deadlocked at 114 - 114 when Jamal Crawford drained 17 - foot jumper with 1 seconds remaining to give the Suns an upset win. Devin Booker led the way with 29 points, a total he supplemented with seven assists, four rebounds and three steals. T.J. Warren provided 19 points, five rebounds, two assists, one steal and one block. Deandre Ayton managed 17 points, seven rebounds and three assists. Trevor Ariza totaled 13 points, 11 rebounds, three assists and two steals. Richaun Holmes led the bench with 12 points, Josh Jackson and Crawford each pitched in 11 points. Giannis Antetokounmpo paced the Bucks with 35 points and added 10 rebounds, three assists and one steal. Malcolm Brogdon totaled 22 points, four assists, three rebounds and one steal. Khris Middleton collected 15 points, six rebounds, four assists and one steal. Eric Bledsoe filled out the stat sheet with 12 points, seven assists, three rebounds, one steal and one block. Ersan Ilyasova led the bench with nine points, four rebounds and three assists. The Suns next pay a visit to the Detroit Pistons on Sunday afternoon, while the Bucks remain home and take on the San Antonio Spurs in a Saturday night showdown.
